findings.fix: Remove user-scalable=no from the viewport meta tag to allow user zooming.
findings.violation: The user-scalable=no attribute disables pinch-zoom, which prevents users from enlarging content for better readability.

findings.fix: Change the color to a darker shade such as #333333 or #404040 to meet minimum contrast ratios.
findings.violation: The text color is #999999 (light gray) on a white background, which fails WCAG AA contrast requirements.

findings.fix: Use max-width: 960px and width: 100% instead of a fixed width to maintain responsiveness.
findings.violation: The fixed width of 960px is not responsive and may cause horizontal scrolling on smaller screens.

findings.fix: Either increase the height to accommodate all content or use overflow:auto to allow scrolling.
findings.violation: Content is hidden with overflow:hidden, which may cut off important information and prevent users from accessing it.

findings.fix: Use a darker color such as #666666 or #333333 for the border to improve visibility.
findings.violation: The border color #9d9d9d (light gray) has insufficient contrast against the background and may be difficult to see.

findings.evidence: div class="icon-delete" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Delete item"
findings.fix: Either convert this to a proper button element or add JavaScript to handle keyboard events for Enter and Space.

findings.fix: Change the label's for attribute to match the select's id: for="topic" instead of for="topic-alt".
